# QuantumRNG

Small RNG scripts designed to compare Classical vs Quantum RNG algorithms

# Architecture
```mermaid
%% Generated by https://gitdiagram.com/ajlrza/quantumrng
flowchart TD

node_classical["Classical RNGs<br/>[classical_rng.py]"]
node_quantum["Quantum RNG<br/>[quantum_rng.py]"]
node_clock["System clock"]
node_numpy["NumPy RNG"]
node_qiskit["Qiskit circuits"]
node_aer["Aer simulator"]

node_classical -->|"gets seed"| node_clock
node_classical -->|"generates samples"| node_numpy
node_quantum -->|"builds circuit"| node_qiskit
node_quantum -->|"runs circuit"| node_aer

click node_classical "https://github.com/ajlrza/quantumrng/blob/main/classical_rng.py"
click node_quantum "https://github.com/ajlrza/quantumrng/blob/main/quantum_rng.py"
```
